question: The lab look is set (round-011 to round-016). Now the logo: which mark and name for taste-lab? Each shows the header with the logo as its first crumb, the mark from 16 to 128px, the lockup on card, muted and page surfaces, and a browser tab.

variants.label: Flask tile
variants.changes: The lucide flask, white on a teal rounded tile, with "taste-lab" in semibold. Safe and app-like.

variants.label: Split dot
variants.changes: A drawn disc split in two halves, teal and coral: A and B side by side. Name as "taste" bold, "lab" muted.

variants.label: Wordmark
variants.changes: Type first: "taste" bold, a coral dot, "lab" in teal mono. The small mark is "t" plus the coral dot in a soft teal tile.

variants.label: Two-tone flask
variants.changes: A drawn flask outline whose liquid is split teal and coral, a comparison inside a lab. Name in plain semibold.
